description: A raked gallery of seats behind a rope and a pane of scuffed acryl, looking down over the KSAB stage — the same lights, cameras and cabling you'd see from the floor, just from up here where the applause light can find you. An APPLAUSE / GASP / AWWW sign hangs dead-eyed over the rail, dark for now. The air is warm with lamp-heat and the breath of a hundred strangers who came to watch.
name: KSAB Studio Gallery
